purpose: Fail closed on an unresolved immutable-publication fork without allowing one task-local metadata conflict to deny service to the global dispatch view. This is control-plane isolation only and selects no publication as operational.

quarantines.reason: The exact post-fork Generation-3 publications are pinned as lineage anchors. Each anchor may advance only through a unique non-branching supersedes chain; any new sibling, third unanchored active head, broken ancestry, cycle, or ambiguous head partition fails closed. The quarantine selects no operational publication and exists only to keep this unresolved fork task-local while legitimate descendants evolve pending ordinary publication-resolution authority.
